## 4. What this means for each day

| Day | Witness | The one question to win that day, and how |
|---|---|---|
| 4 and 11 Nov | De Leon; King | Q6, as background. One fact each, on their own eyes. If Atty. Ramos opens King's cases, three re-direct questions put the 2020 rulings and the 9 July 2021 receipt on the record. |
| 2 Dec | de los Reyes, or no one | Q3, marginally. Optional. |
| 9 Dec | Formal offer | The exhibits that answer Q1, Q2, Q4, Q5 and Q7 by themselves. "Subject to rebuttal." |
| 13 Jan to 10 Mar 2027 | Salvador; Princess; Jomil; Erwin; Gloria if admitted | **Q3** from Salvador's and Princess's own words on rent; the absence of any Llamanzares paper. **Q6** from Princess's blotter entry and Jomil's 2020 record. Short, one-fact questions; the paper is in counsel's hand. |
| Rebuttal | Patricia; certified records | **Q3 and Q4**: no consultation, no ratification, not a party to the partition. **Q6**: the prosecutor's file, the blotter pages, the Civil Case 8563 Answer with its receipt stamp, the Registry's transfer file. |
| Memorandum | — | The "Considering that" lines above, in her ten-question order, each with its article and exhibit page, ending in the WHEREFORE already drafted (playbook §5.4). |
